BrochureContent.Content:
DNG are delighted to present to the market an excellent family home. This stiunning 3 bedroom 3 bathroom home located in the ever popular Ellensborough Estate, No. 29 Ellensborough Court. This property is in superb condition throughout having been upgraded over the years by it current owners. The great design includes modern contemporary kitchen, high qulaity flooring,3 bathrooms, a private rear garden and quiet cul de sac location stunning scenic views of the Dublin Mountains, adjacent large green spaces and off street parking to the front. 

The bright and spacious accommodation briefly comprises entrance hallway, guest bathroom, living room kitchen and dining room. On the first floor there are 3 generous sized bedrooms (master ensuite) and contemporary family bathroom. . Outside there is a private rear garden with patio which is not overlooked. 

Located in a very popular development, No. 29 Ellensborough Court enjoys close proximity to The Square Shopping Centre, Tallaght Hospital, Tallaght IT, Luas, Dublin bus services and a selection of schools, pubs and restaurants. Stunning views and large green spaces are also on your doorstep. There is ease of access to all major roadways to include the M50, M7, N81.
